ArtScalingChange.description: Set the art scaling to one of its values.

BoxData.description: One icon box in a sheet, all four edges inclusive.

BriefingBundle.description: Everything the briefing player needs for one mission file.

BriefingData.description: One briefing of the mission: running time, events, label and caption texts.

BriefingGetArgs.description: The mission to brief: its type and its id in the network menu of that type.

BriefingGetRequest.description: Ask for the briefing bundle of one mission of the network menus or a solo list.

BriefingGetResult.description: Whether the mission was found and read, and its briefing bundle.

BriefingGetSoloArgs.description: The mission to brief: an entry of a sided kind's solo list, by side and file.

CraftKills.description: The pilot's kills of one craft type, named as the statistics page names it.

Debrief.description: One flown battle's debriefing: what was flown, and every number with its name.

DebriefDetail.description: The local pilot's own tables; the rows hold a number other than 0.

DebriefPlayer.description: One player as the battle's end counted it, with its rank and flight group named.

DebriefTeam.description: One team of the battle, with its name from the mission.

ErrorBody.description: Why the command did not run.

ErrorReply.description: The command did not run; the reason.

EventData.description: One script event: its time, its type and its variables.

FontData.description: Font 10: spacing, height, glyph widths, text colors and the atlas cells.

GameOptions.description: The game options a player has: what they set, else the option's default.

GroupData.description: One flight group: what the map draws for it.

GroupKills.description: Kills between the pilot and one flight group.

HelloArgs.description: The page announces its own version.

HelloRequest.description: Ask the launcher to introduce itself.

HelloResult.description: The launcher's version and the revision of the control list.

IconSheetData.description: One icon sheet: its name and its art name.

InstallStatusRequest.description: Ask which install the launcher found.

InstallStatusResult.description: The install found (home shown as ~) and whether Balance of Power is in it.

LaunchCancelRequest.description: Stop the battle that is flying.

LaunchCancelResult.description: Whether a flying launch was stopped, and one plain sentence.

LaunchEndedData.description: How the battle ended: its status, the one line that says so, and a flown battle's debriefing.

LaunchEndedPush.description: Sent to every open page when a battle ends.

LaunchMenuRequest.description: Ask for the solo list of a kind of battle and side.

LaunchSoloArgs.description: One battle to fly: who asks, the kind, the side, the mission's file and the pilot.

LaunchSoloRequest.description: Fly one solo battle in the background, if every value is on the lists.

LaunchSoloResult.description: Whether the battle started (``launch_id`` is 0 when not), and one plain sentence.

LaunchStartedData.description: The battle that started, as a page shows it.

LaunchStartedPush.description: Sent to every open page when a battle starts.

MenuData.description: One mission type's network menu, or the fact that it does not resolve.

MenuEntryData.description: One mission the game's network menu lists.

MissionsListRequest.description: Ask for the network menu of every mission type.

MissionsListResult.description: The network menu of every mission type.

OptionsChangedPush.description: Sent to every open page after a player's game options changed.

OptionsGetArgs.description: The player whose game options to read; null is the account this launcher answers.

OptionsGetRequest.description: Ask for a player's game options.

OptionsResult.description: One player's game options (``player`` is null when no account is linked).

OptionsSetArgs.description: Set one game option of a player to one of its choices.

OptionsSetRequest.description: Set one game option of a player.

PilotChangedData.description: The linked account's pilot name now; null when there is none.

PilotChangedPush.description: Sent to every open page after the bot makes or renames the linked account's pilot.

PilotsListRequest.description: Ask for the pilots the game has.

PilotsListResult.description: The pilots the game has, and whether a battle can be flown at all.

PlayerKills.description: Kills between the pilot and one player.

PointData.description: One briefing point of a flight group: map x and y, and whether it is on.

RankKills.description: The pilot's kills of pilots of one rank.

RankTimes.description: How often a killer of one rank destroyed the pilot.

ResultSummary.description: One kept debriefing in a line: when, which mission, how it ended.

ResultsGetResult.description: The kept debriefing asked for; null when it is not kept.

ResultsListRequest.description: Ask for the kept debriefings, one line each.

ResultsListResult.description: The kept debriefings, the newest first.

SettingsChangedPush.description: Sent to every open page after a setting changed.

ShowMissionArgs.description: The mission to show: its type and its id in the network menu of that type.

ShowMissionPush.description: Sent to every open page when a mission is to be shown.

ShowMissionRequest.description: Tell every open page to show one mission of the network menus or a solo list.

ShowMissionResult.description: Whether the mission was found in its menu and so shown.

ShowSoloMissionArgs.description: The mission to show: an entry of a sided kind's solo list, by side and file.

ShownMission.description: The mission a page is told to show.

ShownSoloMission.description: The solo mission a page is told to show: its side and file, as the solo list gives them.

SoloEntryData.description: One mission a solo list offers; every one flies, opened by the pilot or not.

SoloMenuArgs.description: A kind of battle and a side: the solo list to read.

SoloMenuResult.description: A solo list, or the fact that it does not resolve.

SoundData.description: One sound the player uses: its name in the game's list and its art name.

StatusData.description: What the launcher tells a page that just connected.

StatusPush.description: Sent to a page when it connects.

TeamData.description: One team: its name, its briefing (None: the default) and its background art.
